record.Description: This recall involves VQQQ-branded natural gas patio heaters, models VQQQ-A1 and VQQQ-001. They have a bronze pole with a round base and a silver mushroom-shaped top with an adjustable height of 55 inches to 78 inches. A 24-foot-long gray gas hose is attached to the heater’s base. The brand and model numbers are printed on the product’s purchase receipt.
record.Title: VQQQ Gas Patio Heaters Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire and Burn Hazards

Products.Name: VQQQ Natural Gas Patio Heaters
Products.Type: Gas or Lp Heaters, Not Specified

Images.Caption: Recalled VQQQ Natural Gas Patio Heater

Retailers.Name:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.com from July 2024 through August 2026 for about $346.
Shanxi Yuhe Sheng Maoyi Youxian Gongsi, dba VQQQ, of China

Hazards.Name: Components on the recalled patio heaters can malfunction causing gas to be released, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fire and burn hazards.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled patio heaters immediately, shut the valve at the portable gas source, disconnect the gas hose and contact VQQQ for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write in permanent marker "Recalled" on the heater’s base and send a photo of the marked heater to vqqqrecall@163.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.

ai.summary: About 100 VQQQ natural gas patio heaters, covering models VQQQ-A1 and VQQQ-001, have been recalled. Parts inside the heaters can fail and leak gas, creating a fire and burn hazard that can lead to severe injury or death.
ai.next_steps: Stop using the heater right away, turn off the portable gas supply valve, and detach the hose. To receive a full refund, write "Recalled" on the base with a permanent marker, email a photograph of the marked unit to vqqqrecall@163.com, and then safely throw the heater away.
